card.text: Super-Jupiter 10 au from Beta Pictoris, imaged directly; the first exoplanet heard in radio.

sources.label: Ortiz Ceballos et al. 2026
sources.quote: the first direct detection of auroral radio emission from an exoplanet

introduction.text: Beta Pictoris b is a young super-Jupiter 10 au from its star, glowing at 1,740 K. MeerKAT heard its auroral radio bursts in 2025 and 2026, the first from any exoplanet.

sources.label: Ortiz Ceballos et al. 2026
sources.quote: the first direct detection of auroral radio emission from an exoplanet

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface or colour is imaged; the spin is measured.
